# wdm

> wdm (Webnestify Docker Manager) is a Go terminal application — a Bubble Tea TUI and a CLI over one engine — for installing, updating, and checking a curated set of Docker Compose self-hosting templates. It targets Linux amd64 (Debian 12/13, Ubuntu 24.04/26.04) with Docker 20.10+ and Compose V2.

wdm runs without root or sudo, binds generated stacks to localhost by default, preserves volumes on removal, and verifies signed catalog and release artifacts — failing closed when a signature, checksum, or attestation is missing or invalid.
